experimental_question: Can Creator-0 endogenously decide whether spawning a descendant is epistemically justified — chi(T,E,K) -> {CREATE, DO_NOT_CREATE} — while every realized topology remains refinement-valid, authority-monotone, contract-valid, fresh, and observable?

interpretation_bounds: Bounded functional demonstration at n=8 under one task family per condition; no population-level, optimality, convergence, or unbounded self-improvement claim.
B-condition tasks state their clean-room evidence requirement; the tested judgment is reading evidence topology and self-contamination, not discovering unstated gaps.
Blinding is workspace-enforced (deny rules + tool restriction + audits); designer and decision-maker share a base model.
carried_forward_for_next_experiment: Calibrate chi: compare PredictedValue(child) (decision artifact's expected_information_gain/cost/confidence) against ObservedValue(child) (measured contribution) — calibrated topology economics, not increased recursion depth.
Harden task construction: hide the isolation requirement inside task semantics rather than stating it in evidence requirements.
Promote fresh_launcher.py and proposal_observer.py to shared runtime/formal modules only after a second experiment reuses them unchanged (avoid premature generalization).
Widen descendant roles beyond specification-sufficiency (counterexample search, decomposition) with condition classes of matched surface form.
